verdict.rationale: Ashby ships its own AI agent (Ashby Assistant with custom agents), so asking whether it can consume external MCP servers is a fair question. The evidence only documents Ashby acting as an MCP server that exposes its recruiting data to outside clients like ChatGPT, Claude and Cursor. That is the opposite role and does not show Ashby connecting to third-party MCP servers or using their tools, so there is no evidence for the client capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
